The question of when to use sensitive data like gender or disability status (Q3.5-Q3.6) was also difficult because it requires balancing fairness with potential stigma.

I believe the most critical questions are those about explainability (Q4), as understanding why a student is flagged is crucial for providing appropriate support and building trust. The strong preference in our group for equal recall across groups (Q5.2) aligns with my view that ensuring all students have an equal chance of being supported should be prioritized.

While I understand the privacy concerns, someone might argue that it could help target support to marginalized groups who may need it most. Perhaps an opt-out mechanism could address this tension.
